name: Odoo
description_en:
Odoo is a family of connected business applications covering sales, accounting, inventory, manufacturing, websites and other functions. A useful evaluation specifies both the edition and hosting/commercial plan; Community software, Enterprise subscriptions and the hosted One App Free offer have different boundaries.

This record examines a sales/manufacturing path and the conditions for custom modules, external API access and operating cost. It did not install Odoo or execute an order, integration or upgrade. Current web prices contained multiple billing/discount variants, so no single paid rate is normalized here.
description_zh:
Odoo 是连接销售、会计、库存、制造、网站等业务应用的家族。评估需同时明确版本及托管商业套餐；Community 软件、Enterprise 订阅和托管 One App Free 各有不同边界。

本文研究销售制造路径，以及自定义模块、外部 API 和运营成本条件。未安装 Odoo 或执行订单、集成升级；本次价格文本混有不同付款及折扣值，因此没有归一单一付费费率。

sections.title_en: Evaluate one connected order instead of every app icon
sections.title_zh: 评估一张关联订单而非所有应用图标
sections.en:
The Sales page describes quotations, customer communication, shipping links and related accounting functions. Manufacturing adds production, component traceability and connections with inventory, sales, PLM and maintenance. Shared app navigation is not proof that every function is present in Community or in a particular database.

For a hypothetical made-to-order kit, trace the quotation into the selected fulfillment/manufacturing flow and then to the customer invoice. Inspect components, produced quantity, delivery and payment separately. Add a return and a component shortage. These are proposed acceptance checks, not an installed template or an executed test.
sections.zh:
Sales 页面介绍报价、客户沟通、发运连接及相关会计功能；制造增加生产、组件追溯，以及库存、销售、PLM 和维护连接。共用应用导航不能证明 Community 或某数据库具备全部功能。

可假设一套按订单生产的套件，从报价追踪到所选履约制造流程和客户发票，分别检查组件、产量、交付及付款，再加入退货和缺料。这是建议验收，不是已安装模板或已执行测试。

sections.title_en: Community and Enterprise do not share one blanket license
sections.title_zh: Community 与 Enterprise 不是一个笼统许可
sections.en:
The official licenses page identifies Community LGPLv3 and a separate Odoo Enterprise license, with proprietary terms for many Odoo Apps unless otherwise stated. The page read is under the 20.0 documentation navigation but labels its edition clauses for Odoo 19; actual deployed-version terms should be checked.

This family is therefore recorded as mixed licensing rather than universally permissive or universally proprietary. Source access does not remove Enterprise subscription conditions, and app/theme licenses need their own check. The website’s free hosted app offer is a commercial scope choice, not a license declaration for all code.
sections.zh:
官方许可页列出 Community 的 LGPLv3，以及单独的 Enterprise 许可；许多 Odoo Apps 如无另行声明采用专有条件。此次页面位于 20.0 文档导航下，但版本条款标为 Odoo 19，需按实际部署版本核对。

因此整个家族记录为混合许可，不能笼统说全部宽松开源或全部专有。能查看源码不解除 Enterprise 订阅条件，应用主题也需各自查许可；网站免费托管应用方案属于商业范围选择，不是所有代码的许可声明。

sections.title_en: Custom modules and externally initiated API calls affect the plan
sections.title_zh: 定制模块和外部发起 API 会影响套餐
sections.en:
The pricing FAQ places Standard on Odoo Online without custom modules. Custom can use Online, Odoo.sh or on-premise; Odoo.sh hosting itself is excluded from the subscription price. Studio, multi-company and external API are listed with Custom.

The FAQ defines External API as external software initiating calls into Odoo. Odoo itself calling a payment provider, carrier or bank service is described differently and does not automatically require that external-API entitlement. Check the actual direction and product operation before choosing. Self-hosting also leaves security, backups and operation with the customer under the Enterprise terms.
sections.zh:
定价 FAQ 将 Standard 放在不允许定制模块的 Odoo Online；Custom 可选 Online、Odoo.sh 或本地，而 Odoo.sh 托管费本身不含在订阅价。Studio、多公司和外部 API 列于 Custom。

FAQ 把 External API 定义为外部软件主动调用 Odoo；Odoo 主动调用支付、承运商或银行服务则另行区分，不会自动需要该外部 API 权限。选套餐前应检查真实调用方向及操作；Enterprise 条款还要求自托管客户负责安全和备份运营。

sections.title_en: One App Free has a dependency boundary
sections.title_zh: One App Free 受应用依赖边界约束
sections.en:
The pricing page offers one app free with unlimited users on Odoo Online, including dependencies needed by that chosen app. Installing unrelated additional applications can move the database to a paid plan. This is different from the self-hosted Community edition.

The same FAQ discusses free-plan companies/Studio as well as upgrade triggers, so confirm the precise intended configuration before changing it. Paid users and Light Users are also distinct commercial categories; portal customers/suppliers are not ordinary paying backend users. Employee records without linked users can affect Light User treatment. Do not equate employee headcount, portal visitors and full backend seats.
sections.zh:
定价页提供 Odoo Online 上一个应用免费、不限用户，包含该应用必需依赖；安装无关额外应用可能转为付费。这与自托管 Community 不同。

同一 FAQ 同时讨论免费方案公司与 Studio 及升级触发，因此更改前需确认具体配置。付费用户和 Light Users 也是不同商业类别，门户客户供应商不等于普通收费后台用户；未关联用户的员工记录可能影响 Light User 处理，不能混同员工总数、门户访客与完整后台席位。

sections.title_en: Price the retained plan and services after the initial offer
sections.title_zh: 按首次优惠后保留的套餐和服务算费用
sections.en:
The page read on 22 October 2026 displayed both monthly/annual and discounted/undiscounted paid values. The exact chosen combination was not established, so numeric normalization remains unknown. It states an initial-user discount valid for twelve months and excludes implementation/expert services, in-app purchase credits, custom-code maintenance and Odoo.sh hosting.

Prepare the actual full/light users, companies, apps, API/custom-code requirements and migration scope for a written quote. SMS, document scanning or other usage credits are not automatically covered by an all-apps fee. Support and upgrades have contractual scopes; a public unlimited-support phrase does not prove custom development is maintained without charge.
sections.zh:
2026 年 10 月 22 日读取的页面混有月付年付、优惠及原价值，未确立具体选择组合，因此数字归一保持未知。页面说明初始订购用户优惠有效十二个月，并排除实施专家服务、应用内购买额度、定制代码维护及 Odoo.sh 托管。

书面报价应准备完整及轻用户、公司、应用、API 定制和迁移范围。所有应用费不自动包含短信、单据扫描等用量额度；支持升级各有合同范围，“不限支持”不能证明定制开发免费维护。

sections.title_en: Versions, localizations and recovery still require acceptance
sections.title_zh: 版本、本地化和恢复仍需验收
sections.en:
Prepare charts/taxes, product units, warehouses, BOMs, opening balances and role ownership, then validate the chosen order cycle in the retained edition and host. Test an unapproved change, duplicate import, failed provider call and an upgrade of custom modules in a separate environment. These are evaluation suggestions.

Odoo is worth investigating when connected business applications and configurable workflows justify implementation ownership. A single-purpose need may fit a narrower offer, but no reviewed alternative is approved here. Specific local tax/payroll coverage, hardware, installed API version, export/restore and performance were not tested; a translated profile does not establish UI localization.
sections.zh:
应准备科目税项、物品单位、仓库、BOM、期初余额及角色责任，再在最终版本和托管中验收订单周期；可在独立环境测试未批准变更、重复导入、服务商调用失败及定制模块升级。这些属于评估建议。

若相连应用和可配置流程值得承担实施责任，Odoo 可以调查；单用途可能只需较窄方案，但本文未批准替代关系。具体税务薪资覆盖、硬件、已安装 API 版本、导出恢复及性能均未测试，正文翻译也不证明界面本地化。
